name: eQTL Catalogue

version.value: Release 7 and pre-release r8_beta (FTP directory dated 2026-01-28); home page cites 32 published studies

scope: Uniformly processed gene-expression and splicing QTL summary statistics and SuSiE fine-mapped credible sets from public human studies.

quantitative.summary: Beta, SE, p-value, PIP and credible-set membership.
quantitative.units: SD of normalised expression per allele

licence.name: Data under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International; code under Apache 2.0 (eQTL Catalogue License page)
licence.redistribution: Attribution required; cite Kerimov et al. 2021 (Nat Genet 53:1290) and Kerimov et al. 2023 (PLoS Genet 19:e1010932)

coverage_limitations: REST API v2 and v3 endpoints return HTTP 410 (retired); access is via FTP only
known_omissions: Metadata tables are hosted in a GitHub repository outside this session scope

reuse_decision.rationale: Open Targets lists the eQTL Catalogue among its integrated data sources, and the acquired Open Targets credible_set dataset already holds 1,718,748 eQTL, 844,764 sQTL, 521,558 transcript-usage QTL and 123,630 single-cell eQTL credible-set rows with effect sizes. Which of its projects are eQTL Catalogue datasets was not matched, so the catalogue's own files (summary statistics and credible sets per dataset, now under a new data-access scheme with an r8_beta release) are not fetched until a gap in the Open Targets coverage is shown.

status.notes: FTP directory listing and licence page readable; the old REST API is gone (its replacement is documented under /Data_access/) and no data file was fetched.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Public human studies, each with its own tissue or cell type, condition, quantification method and sample size, processed uniformly. Effects are changes in an expression or splicing phenotype per alternate allele in that context.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Statistical association with summary statistics and SuSiE fine-mapped credible sets. Credible sets narrow the candidate variants but do not establish the causal variant.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low to moderate for the regulatory axis. A QTL says a variant, or a linked variant, is associated with expression or splicing of a gene in that context; colocalisation with a trait and functional assays are needed to connect it to a phenotype.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: A molecular phenotype (gene expression or splice-event usage) in the studied tissue or cell type; not a disease phenotype.
evidence_profile.absence_means: No QTL means no association was detected in the sampled contexts at the available power. Tissues, cell states, developmental stages and rare alleles that were not sampled are unaddressed.
